content: XCOM 2 Geoscape: time is the resource; scanning at POIs costs time; up to ~7 concurrent choices on map; Dark Events run up to 3 timers at once; Infirmary/engineer slot halves wound recovery; Resistance HQ passive bonuses. Community consensus: vanilla Geoscape is 'move and wait', Long War 2 adds depth via more concurrent demands. WotC fatigue: Will <66% Tired (8-12 days), <33% Shaken (14-20 days, cannot deploy); Tired soldiers blocked from covert ops but can staff facilities, forcing roster rotation.
